 Qatar MotoGP Sprint red-flagged after Pecco Bagnaia accident
 The Qatar Sprint race has been red-flagged after a collision between Fermin Aldeguer and Pecco Bagnaia.
 Peter McLaren 07 Nov 2026 Share Big Pecco Bagnaia accident halts the Qatar MotoGP Sprint. © Gold and Goose Prefer Crash.Net on Google See our stories more often Add The Qatar MotoGP Sprint race has been red-flagged after a big opening lap accident for Pecco Bagnaia.
 Bagnaia climbed to third at the start, behind only Aprilia pole qualifier Marco Bezzecchi and factory Ducati team-mate Marc Marquez , before losing out to Fabio di Giannantonio and Raul Fernandez.
 Disaster struck when Bagnaia was torpedoed by returning Gresini Ducati rider Fermin Aldeguer into the final corner.
 Aldeguer tried to overtake Pedro Acosta when he missed his braking point and rammed into the side of Bagnaia ahead, sending the double MotoGP champion into a huge highside.
 Bagnaia was conscious but carried away on a stretcher, triggering the red flags.
